description: What to patch first: the vulnerabilities with the highest priority score (exploitation, EPSS, CVSS, automatability) among those with activity in a time window, optionally narrowed to an ecosystem, vendor or product.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem, such as npm, PyPI, Maven, Go or crates.io.

kev.description: Only entries in the CISA KEV catalog.

product.description: Exact product name, such as log4j or exchange server.

vendor.description: Exact vendor name, such as apache or microsoft.

name: top_priority
title: Highest-priority vulnerabilities
